decisions.reason: It fits the firm's core strength in trusted second-channel authentication and secure communication, so its relatedness to existing know-how and the firm's R&D capacity make continued improvement and bundling commercially attractive.

This architecture product is highly cumulative on the firm's established cryptography and platform knowledge, and its move to a dedicated page suggests enough traction to justify further learning and development.

The hardware signature token is close to the firm's signing and authentication business and matches its existing hardware and SDK capabilities, while the dedicated page indicates a market position worth refining rather than abandoning.

Although technically related, the payment-network compliance suite appears less central to the firm's broader identity ecosystem and showed weaker market prominence, so the firm would likely reallocate resources to products where its absorptive capacity is stronger and easier to scale.
